# Pair $N$: flags first (run 4), then the gate in the portal (ahw_portal_tmp) and the exit in the
# nearest ring system (ahw_node_tmp), in the node's next free slot.
ahw_spike_make_pair = {
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		set_star_flag = ahw_entry_$N$
		set_variable = { which = ahw_pair value = $N$ }
	}
	event_target:ahw_node_tmp = {
		set_star_flag = ahw_exit_$N$
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 0 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 30 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 60 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 90 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 90 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 120 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 120 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 150 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 150 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 180 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 210 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 210 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 240 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 240 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 270 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 270 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 300 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 300 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 330 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_gate_$N$ orbit_distance = 230 orbit_angle = 330 }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_node_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 0 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 1 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 2 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 120 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 3 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 4 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 240 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 5 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 300 orbit_angle = 300 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 6 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 7 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 90 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 8 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 150 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 9 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 210 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 10 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 270 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 11 } }
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 220 orbit_angle = 330 }
		}
		else = {
			spawn_megastructure = { type = ahw_spike_entry_exit_$N$ orbit_distance = 150 orbit_angle = 45 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = ahw_exits value = 1 }
	}
	log = "AHW SPIKE pair $N$ built"
}

# The next pair, numbered by the counter ahw_pairs on ring node 1.
ahw_spike_make_next_pair = {
	event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { change_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { check_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 1 } } }
		ahw_spike_make_pair = { N = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { check_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 2 } } }
		ahw_spike_make_pair = { N = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { check_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 3 } } }
		ahw_spike_make_pair = { N = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { check_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 4 } } }

	else_if = {
		limit = { event_target:ahw_ring_1 = { check_variable = { which = ahw_pairs value = 5 } } }

		ahw_spike_make_pair = { N = 32 }
	}
	else = {
		log = "AHW SPIKE no entry-point type left (more empires than PAIRS)"
	}
}

# Finds the galaxy's centre: two probe systems leapfrog corewards from the innermost system; the
# better one ends as event_target:ahw_centre_system. No scope.
ahw_spike_find_centre = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.15 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.15 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.2 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.2 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.25 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.25 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.3 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.3 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.4 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.4 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_system = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.6 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } }
		random_system = { limit = { distance_to_core_percent < 0.6 NOT = { has_star_flag = ahw_unclaimable } } save_global_event_target_as = ahw_inner_tmp }
	}
	event_target:ahw_inner_tmp = {
		spawn_system = {
			min_distance = 20
			max_distance = 20
			max_jumps = 0
			direction = corewards
			initializer = ahw_spike_core_init
			hyperlane = no
			effect = { save_global_event_target_as = ahw_probe_a }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = {
		spawn_system = {
			min_distance = 10
			max_distance = 10
			max_jumps = 0
			direction = corewards
			initializer = ahw_spike_core_init
			hyperlane = no
			effect = { save_global_event_target_as = ahw_probe_t }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = { ahw_spike_measure = yes }
	event_target:ahw_probe_t = { ahw_spike_measure = yes }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 40 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 30 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 20 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 15 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 10 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 7 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	ahw_spike_probe_step = { S = 5 }
	event_target:ahw_probe_a = {
		save_global_event_target_as = ahw_centre_system
		log = "AHW SPIKE centre: best probe at distance_to_core_percent \\[This.ahw_d] (0 = the centre)"
	}
}

# Places the portal (ahw_portal_tmp, spawned at angle 0, PORTAL_R from its anchor ahw_x_tmp) so its
# lane arrives in the anchor system farthest from the anchor's other lanes; ahw_best_a = the angle.
# Q (run 10): does move_system honour min/max_orientation_angle as spawn_system does?
ahw_spike_place_portal = {
	ahw_spike_measure_lanes = { VAR = ahw_d0 }
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 90 max_orientation_angle = 90 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no } }
	ahw_spike_measure_lanes = { VAR = ahw_d90 }
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 180 max_orientation_angle = 180 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no } }
	ahw_spike_measure_lanes = { VAR = ahw_d180 }
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 270 max_orientation_angle = 270 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no } }
	ahw_spike_measure_lanes = { VAR = ahw_d270 }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_c value = ahw_d180 }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_c value = ahw_d0 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_s value = ahw_d270 }
			subtract_variable = { which = ahw_s value = ahw_d90 }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = -1000 }
		set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 0 }
	}
	# angle 0: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.5 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.0 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 0 }
		}
	}
	# angle 30: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.433 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.25 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 30 }
		}
	}
	# angle 60: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.25 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.433 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 60 }
		}
	}
	# angle 90: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.0 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.5 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 90 }
		}
	}
	# angle 120: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.25 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.433 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 120 }
		}
	}
	# angle 150: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.433 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.25 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 150 }
		}
	}
	# angle 180: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.5 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = -0.0 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 180 }
		}
	}
	# angle 210: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.433 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.25 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 210 }
		}
	}
	# angle 240: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.25 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.433 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 240 }
		}
	}
	# angle 270: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = 0.0 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.5 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 270 }
		}
	}
	# angle 300: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.25 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.433 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 300 }
		}
	}
	# angle 330: the worst margin over the anchor's other lanes
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = 1000 } }
	event_target:ahw_x_tmp = {
		every_neighbor_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:ahw_portal_tmp } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_c }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_t value = -0.433 }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_u value = ahw_s }
			multiply_variable = { which = ahw_u value = 0.25 }
			change_variable = { which = ahw_t value = ahw_u }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_t value < event_target:ahw_portal_tmp.ahw_m } }
				event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = { set_variable = { which = ahw_m value = prev.ahw_t } }
			}
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_m value > ahw_best } }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best value = ahw_m }
			set_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 330 }
		}
	}
	event_target:ahw_portal_tmp = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 0 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 0 max_orientation_angle = 0 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 30 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 30 max_orientation_angle = 30 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 60 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 60 max_orientation_angle = 60 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 90 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 90 max_orientation_angle = 90 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 120 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 120 max_orientation_angle = 120 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 150 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 150 max_orientation_angle = 150 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 180 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 180 max_orientation_angle = 180 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 210 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 210 max_orientation_angle = 210 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 240 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 240 max_orientation_angle = 240 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 270 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 270 max_orientation_angle = 270 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 300 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 300 max_orientation_angle = 300 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = ahw_best_a value = 330 } }
			move_system = { target = event_target:ahw_x_tmp min_distance >= 15 max_distance <= 15 min_orientation_angle = 330 max_orientation_angle = 330 max_jumps = 0 hyperlane = no }
		}
		log = "AHW SPIKE portal placed off \\[ahw_x_tmp.GetName] at angle \\[This.ahw_best_a]: worst lane margin \\[This.ahw_best] (+15 = opposite every other lane, 0 = sideways, -15 = beside one; 1000 = no other lane)"
	}
}
